source.note: Values hand-transcribed from the typeset PDF. The paper states its accuracy as 'less than +/-10%, and most errors were less than +/-5%' for m >= n.

systems.name: lorenz
systems.equation: xdot = sigma(y-x); ydot = x(R-z)-y; zdot = xy - bz

systems.name: rossler
systems.equation: xdot = -y-z; ydot = x + ay; zdot = b + z(x-c)

measured_2026_07_26.note: Accuracy degrades as m rises past the topological dimension, as the paper describes: logistic reaches -7.7% at m=5.
